title: Flag a worker pane that has gone silent as stalled
notes: From the Vercel Board comparison (Vercel's 5-minute claim lease). Today a hung worker, for example one stuck on a test that never ends, sits in Doing and holds a pane-pool slot forever. Do: a heartbeat from what the app already sees (hook events, pty output, turn state); a worker running with no sign of life for N minutes (a setting, default 20) is shown as stalled in pane list/status and the workers popup, and main gets one notice. It keeps its slot and is never killed or released automatically; the user or main decides. Decision module (stalled or not, from the last signs) with a test; workers docs updated.

comments.body: Main: card cfd56f18 (workers popup shows the queue) is in flight and edits chat-workers-view.ts, anchored-popup.ts and session-requests.ts. Build the stalled decision, its signals and pane list/status first; do the popup's stalled marker last, after cfd56f18 merges (merge origin/main in first).
